subject.title: fix: clear stale Claude CLI sessions after failover

question: Should channel and follow-up claude-cli runs clear a reused binding on both FailoverError and AbortError before this PR merges?
rationale: The code path is a valid narrow bug fix, but it deliberately changes persisted session-state cleanup timing for failed channel work, so a human should accept the upgrade/session behavior before landing.

options.title: Accept command-path parity
options.body: Land this PR with the same FailoverError and AbortError stale-session clearing policy already used by command attempts.

options.title: Narrow to FailoverError only
options.body: Ask for the helper to clear only FailoverError if AbortError should not invalidate channel-runner Claude CLI bindings.

options.title: Require live transport proof
options.body: Pause for a redacted live gateway or Telegram reproduction if focused terminal proof is not enough for this session-state change.

recommendation.title: Accept command-path parity
recommendation.body: Land this PR with the same FailoverError and AbortError stale-session clearing policy already used by command attempts.

likelyOwner.reason: CLI backend fallback and CLI session reuse history make this the best available owner for the session-state policy choice.
